parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ classified_kind: $json.classified_kind, classification_confidence: $json.classification_confidence, extracted_summary: ($json.summary_en || '') + ' | ' + ($json.summary_ar || ''), extracted_text: JSON.stringify($json.extracted_fields || {}), notes: 'Phase 2 auto-extract' }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ tenant_id: $json.tenant_id, voucher_id: $json.voucher_id, status: 'running', model: 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929', started_at: new Date().toISOString() }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929',
  max_tokens: 4000,
  system: 'You are a Saudi real-estate escrow trustee auditor. You audit payment vouchers (وثائق صرف) against contracts, invoices, completion certificates, and escrow rules. The source documents were OCR-extracted from Arabic PDFs in a prior step; their structured fields appear under context.extracted (voucher_extracted, invoice_extracts, cert_extracts, extract_extracts, approval_extracts, receipt_extracts, contract_extracts, ledger_extracts, bank_statement_extracts, other_extracts). Field values may be in Arabic — treat them as authoritative document evidence. Return ONLY a single JSON object — no prose, no markdown, no code fences. The JSON must match this exact shape:
{
  "overall_verdict": "approved" | "rejected" | "needs_review",
  "summary": "one short paragraph explaining the verdict",
  "checks": [ { "rule_code": string, "rule_title_en": string, "rule_title_ar": string, "severity": "blocking" | "warning" | "info", "status": "pass" | "fail" | "warn" | "needs_info" | "skipped", "reasoning": string, "evidence_quote": string, "expected_value": string, "actual_value": string, "ai_confidence": number } ]
}
Run ALL 13 rules below in order. Because extracted document fields are now available in context.extracted, rules that previously required PDF content (RULE_03 price match, RULE_04 receipt confirmation, RULE_08 completion vs extract, RULE_12 supplier ledger) MUST attempt pass/fail using the extracted fields rather than defaulting to needs_info. Only fall back to needs_info when the required document is missing or its classification_confidence is below 0.6. evidence_quote should cite Arabic or English text from extracted_fields where possible.

Rules:
RULE_01_DOC_SEQUENCE — voucher_number must follow the project sequence; flag gaps/duplicates against prior_vouchers.
RULE_02_DATE_PROXIMITY — voucher_date must be within ~14 days of today; older vouchers warn.
RULE_03_PRICE_MATCH — invoice line prices (extracted.invoice_extracts[*].extracted_fields.line_items[*].unit_price) must match contract line items (contracts.line_items.agreed_unit_price_sar). Pass/fail per match; flag mismatched line.
RULE_04_RECEIPT_CONFIRMATION — materials need a storekeeper confirmation; services need a department approval. Use extracted.receipt_extracts and extracted.approval_extracts to evidence this. If neither exists for a construction voucher, fail with reasoning.
RULE_05_ACCOUNT_TYPE_MATCH — voucher.expense_nature must equal voucher.account.account_type (construction → construction escrow; admin/marketing/security → non_construction).
RULE_06_ACCOUNT_SUFFICIENCY — voucher.total_sar must be ≤ voucher.account.current_balance_sar.
RULE_07_BENEFICIARY_DETAIL — voucher.beneficiary supplier name + bank account must match the master record (already joined). Cross-check against extracted.invoice_extracts[*].extracted_fields.supplier_name_ar / supplier_name_en.
RULE_08_COMPLETION_VS_EXTRACT — if voucher relates to construction work, compare extracted.extract_extracts[*].extracted_fields.claimed_completion_pct against latest completion_certificates.completion_pct AND extracted.cert_extracts[*].extracted_fields.completion_pct. Fail if the contractor extract claims materially more than the certified completion.
RULE_09_NO_DUPLICATE_PAYMENT — voucher.allocations[].invoice.total_sar minus prior allocations must be ≥ allocation amount. Sum of allocations against any invoice may not exceed invoice.total_sar.
RULE_10_DEVELOPER_NAME_ON_INVOICE — voucher.allocations[].invoice.issued_to_developer_id must equal voucher.project.developer_id. ALSO cross-check extracted.invoice_extracts[*].extracted_fields.issued_to against voucher.project.developer.name_ar / name_en.
RULE_11_AUTHORIZED_SIGNER — voucher.signer must exist, status="active", and signing_limit_sar ≥ voucher.total_sar. Cross-check against extracted.approval_extracts[*].extracted_fields.signer_name.
RULE_12_SUPPLIER_LEDGER — invoice should appear in developer's supplier ledger. Use extracted.ledger_extracts[*].extracted_fields.entries[*].invoice_number to verify the voucher's invoices are present in the ledger. If no ledger extract is available, mark needs_info.
RULE_13_VOUCHER_TOTAL_EQ_INVOICES — voucher.total_sar must equal sum(voucher.allocations[].allocated_amount_sar). If no allocations exist, mark needs_info.',
  messages: [
    {
      role: 'user',
      content: 'Audit this voucher. Return JSON only.

VOUCHER + CONTEXT (includes extracted Arabic document fields under context.extracted):
' + JSON.stringify($json, null, 2)
    }
  ]
}) }}
